entries.title: Hebrews 2:1
segments:
Therefore, etc.  That is, since it is the revelation of God in Christ, which now concerns us instead of the former dispensation in which angels were employed as His ministers, let us give the more earnest heed.
 

 
 To the things that were heard. The gospel truths.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:2
segments: Spoken through angels. The Jews considered the word of God in the Old Testament as having been spoken through angels as mediators.  See
.  The tradition of the rabbis was that the law came through angels.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:3
segments: them that heard. The chosen witnesses.  See

entries.title: Hebrews 2:4
segments: God also bearing witness. The divine power was manifested through the human agent so that the truth of the message was attested by miracles, gifts of healing, etc.  See

entries.title: Hebrews 2:5
segments: The world to come. The new era, the Christian ages ushered in by the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:7
segments: A little lower. Man, living in a world of trial and temptation, is for a little while lower than the angels.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:9
segments:
A little lower than the angels, even Jesus. Implying the fact of the incarnation of Christ.
 

 
 Taste of death. Through  the bitterness of death Jesus became complete in his sympathy with suffering humanity.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:10
segments: It became him, etc.  It was in harmony with the purpose of God that Christ should become the perfect Saviour of mankind through suffering.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:11
segments: All of one. God. Jesus, by nature the Son of God, and Christians, made holy through Christ, have one spiritual Father.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:14
segments: Had the power of death. Satan has the permitted, subordinate power of death in so far as he tempts men to sin, which ends in death.  (

entries.title: Hebrews 2:16
segments: Help to the seed of Abraham. But not because help as to be denied to the Gentiles.  'Help' means here that the Jews were favored by the fact that Jesus was born of their race.

entries.title: Hebrews 2:17
segments: Merciful and faithful high priest. When he offered himself as a voluntary sacrifice upon the cross.  See
